scenarios.question: Why did revenue drop last week?
scenarios.rootCause: Revenue dropped 38.8% on Thursday 2026-10-08 because web orders collapsed (channel = web alone accounts for more than the full $12,621.71 shortfall, while other channel values moved the other way), starting shortly after the web-checkout v2.14.0 deploy at 08:40 UTC (later rolled back), shipped by carla.m; refunds also spiked on 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09; active customers also dropped on 2026-10-08. Customer segment mix was ruled out as the driver.
